review_items.concrete_reason: The north-west door opens into an unoccupied north lane. cabinet_dishes_west begins south of the door clearance, and table_meal_east plus bench_east_diners are far enough east and south to preserve a natural entry turn.

All five targets are reachable from the entry. The north lane branches to cabinet_dishes_west and the table, while the central and south lanes reach chair_west_diner, bench_east_diners, and console_serving_south without crossing a chair pull-out zone.

table_meal_east has a dedicated south setting strip, bench_east_diners is entered from its open north end, chair_west_diner has an unobstructed west pull-out area, cabinet_dishes_west presents into a clear service aisle, and console_serving_south has a full north-side serving zone.

table_meal_east, bench_east_diners, and chair_west_diner form a compact three-person meal group. cabinet_dishes_west is a separate retrieval point and console_serving_south is a separate serving point, giving the room a clear meal-service sequence.

The cabinet and console occupy opposite perimeter walls, and the table group is placed to the east-middle rather than filling the room center. The north entry lane and east window strip remain visibly open.

A two-person bench paired with one loose chair is a plausible daily household arrangement. Storing dishes at cabinet_dishes_west and placing food on console_serving_south keeps preparation and clearing out of the seat access path.

bench_east_diners and chair_west_diner face one another across table_meal_east. cabinet_dishes_west faces east into the room, and console_serving_south faces north into its service strip; no seated object faces directly into a wall or opening.

The table-and-bench pair is the primary visual and functional center. The west cabinet and south console establish a secondary service frame, while the single loose chair remains deliberately subordinate and flexible.

The closest dining_room_authored_001 uses a north banquette, three loose chairs, a south-west door, a north-east window, and one east-wall cabinet. This scene instead has an east bench plus one west chair, a north-west door, an east window, a west dish cabinet, and a distinct south serving console; its category Jaccard is 0.571429 and its frozen graph has only one table-to-chair edge.
